datasets.name: SaaS customers
datasets.description: 6,000 B2B SaaS accounts with plan, seats, MRR, activity, support load, NPS, churn flag, churn reason and free-text feedback. Synthetic, seeded, deliberately correlated (churn rises with tickets, low NPS, Starter plan, Retail, inactivity).
suggested_questions: Why are customers churning and where is revenue at risk?
Which segments have the best expansion potential?
Does support ticket volume predict churn, and does it differ by plan?

datasets.name: E-commerce orders
datasets.description: 8,000 US online orders across 6 categories and ~42 products with pricing, discounts, shipping time, returns, star rating and review text. Synthetic, seeded, deliberately correlated (returns rise with slow shipping, Apparel, deep discounts and low ratings).
suggested_questions: What drives returns and low ratings?
Where should we invest marketing next quarter?
Which products and states have the worst shipping experience?

datasets.name: SF Airbnb listings
datasets.description: Real San Francisco Airbnb listings (hotdata.dev mirror of the Inside Airbnb scrape, 6,102 rows kept from 7,535): name, neighbourhood, room type, minimum nights, reviews, availability, capacity, bedrooms, review score and listing description. The scrape's price column is empty, so `price` is a modelled nightly rate derived from room type, neighbourhood, capacity and rating.
suggested_questions: What makes a listing command a premium price?
Which neighborhoods are under-supplied for families?
How do 30-night minimum listings differ from short-stay listings?
